subject: Seller intake — Ampersand AI: marketplace billing & PO exceptions
messages:
From: Evelyn Carter <evelyn.carter@ampersandai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ampersandai.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seller intake — Ampersand AI (marketplace billing + PO flow)

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting the legal/finance intake to get Ampersand AI set up as a seller on the major cloud marketplaces so we can list our managed inference product. To accelerate the vendor activation, can you confirm Redwood's vendor intake checklist and any marketplace-specific PO requirements?

High-level ask from our side:
- We prefer consolidated monthly billing across marketplaces (single PO/month) if possible.
- Our finance team needs to know which legal entity to reference on POs and invoices per cloud (AWS vs Azure vs GCP).
- Any seller IDs / marketplace metadata you need us to provide (MPN, Marketplace Seller ID, billing account email, etc.).

I've attached a short seller profile and prelim finance contact: Ampersand_Seller_Profile.pdf.

Can we target a 30-minute sync early next week to resolve any exceptions?

Thanks,
Evelyn Carter
Head of Finance Operations
Ampersand AI
Attachment: Ampersand_Seller_Profile.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Carter <evelyn.carter@ampersandai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seller intake — Ampersand AI (marketplace billing + PO flow)

Evelyn — thanks for the profile and for outlining the constraints. Looping in Vanessa (finance ops / marketplace billing) and Laura (partner activation lead) so we can align across clouds.

Quick answers and what we need from you:

1) Legal entity on POs/invoices
- For AWS Marketplace we typically invoice through our US seller entity: Redwood Inference USA, Inc.
- For Azure Marketplace the invoice may need to flow through our commercial reseller path; sometimes partner MPN linkage is required.
- For GCP Marketplace there is a separate billing account flow and some customers request invoices to their own procurement contact.

2) Aggregated monthly billing
- AWS: aggregated monthly invoicing can be supported if you opt into AWS Marketplace consolidated billing; we need your marketplace buyer account ID and invoice preference.
- Azure: aggregation is possible via CSP/reseller agreements — will need your MPN ID and preferred invoice recipient.
- GCP: supports monthly billing for some sellers but requires a signed commercial agreement and billing account email.

3) Required artifacts (please provide):
- Signed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- Company legal name and billing address exactly as you want it on invoices
- Marketplace seller IDs (MPN / AWS Seller ID / GCP vendor id)
- Copy of any internal PO template if you require specific line items (tax, unit price, SKU).

Action items:
- I'm attaching our Redwood Vendor Intake Form — please complete and return so Finance can open a vendor file.
- If you have any onsite procurement templates that mandate special wording (e.g., PO to be issued to a different legal entity), flag them in the form.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx

Proposed next step: 30-min call Tue 2027-04-27 10:00 PT?

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

- Attached: Ampersand_W9.pdf, Ampersand_MPN_ID.png, and a signed vendor agreement via DocuSign.

- Please confirm that Redwood can accept a Net-45 term for GCP invoicing and that the PO legal name restriction is acceptable. If this requires a special routing or approval we can include a short cover note in the PO.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/ABC12345
